options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
How to win the multiworld.
scenarios   = complete `required_scenarios` Dragon Adventure scenarios
              (the classic goal).
time_scrolls= collect `time_scrolls_required` Time Scrolls (McGuffin items
              shuffled across the multiworld). Collecting them all UNLOCKS
              the Final Saga (otherwise locked); you then complete that
              saga to 'repair the timeline' and win. Encourages exploring
              far more of the game to find your scrolls.
both        = satisfy BOTH conditions to win (N scenarios AND the Final
              Saga completed after gathering the scrolls).
options.doc_fr:
Comment gagner le multimonde.
scénarios = tous les scénarios `required_scenarios` Dragon Adventure (le but classique).
time scrolls= collectez `time_scrolls_required` Time Scrolls (éléments de McGuffin shufflés dans le multimonde). Recueillir tous les UNLOCKS la Saga Finale (autrement verrouillé); vous terminez ensuite cette saga pour 'réparer la chronologie' et gagner. Encourage à explorer beaucoup plus du jeu pour trouver vos rouleaux.
les deux = satisfaire les deux conditions pour gagner (N scénarios ET la Saga finale terminée après la collecte des rouleaux).

options.name: Final Saga
options.doc:
For the time_scrolls goal: which saga the Time Scrolls unlock as the
final confrontation. It stays locked until you've gathered enough scrolls,
then opens; completing it wins. Defaults to Evil Dragon of Absolute
Destruction — the climactic Shadow Dragon saga, a fitting finale for
repairing the shattered timeline.
options.doc_fr: For the time_scrolls goal: qui saga le Time Scrolls débloque comme la confrontation finale. Il reste verrouillé jusqu'à ce que vous ayez rassemblé assez de rouleaux, puis s'ouvre; le compléter gagne. Défauts au mal Dragon de destruction absolue — la saga du Dragon d'ombre, une finale appropriée pour réparer le calendrier brisé.

options.name: Excluded Sagas
options.doc:
Sagas (chapters) to DISABLE. By default this is empty, meaning ALL 24
sagas are included. List any saga names here to exclude them: their mission
checks and unlock item are removed from the pool and you never need to play
them. The Final Saga (your goal) is ALWAYS kept enabled even if listed here.
Example: ['Lord Slug', 'Makyo Star'].

Valid saga names: Saiyan Saga, Tree of Might, Lord Slug, Final Battle,
Frieza Saga, Makyo Star, Cooler's Revenge, The Return of Cooler, The Story
of Trunks, Android Saga, Super Android 13, Broly: The Legendary Super Saiyan,
Ultimate Future Warrior, Bojack Unbound, Majin Buu Saga, Broly: The Second
Coming, Fusion Reborn, Wrath of the Dragon, Baby, The Avenger, Ultimate
Android, Evil Dragon of Absolute Destruction, Fateful Brothers, Beautiful
Treachery..., Destined Rivals.

options.name: Time Scrolls Required
options.doc:
For the time_scrolls goal: how many Time Scrolls you must collect to win.
Must be <= Time Scrolls Total.
options.doc_fr:
For the time_scrolls goal: combien de défilements de temps vous devez recueillir pour gagner.
Doit être <= Temps de défilement Total.

options.name: Time Scrolls Total
options.doc:
For the time_scrolls goal: how many Time Scrolls exist in the item pool.
Extra scrolls beyond 'required' give the generator flexibility and let you
win without finding literally all of them. Clamped to >= required.
options.doc_fr:
For the time_scrolls goal: combien de défilements temporels existent dans le pool d'articles.
Des rouleaux supplémentaires au-delà de 'requis' donnent la flexibilité du générateur et vous permettent de gagner sans les trouver littéralement tous. Clampé à >= requis.

options.name: Required Scenarios
options.doc:
Number of Dragon Adventure scenarios that must be fully completed
(all missions cleared) to win. There are 24 scenarios total.

options.name: Starting Scenarios
options.doc:
How many random scenarios are unlocked from the start (their unlock
items are precollected). The rest are gated behind unlock items in the
multiworld.
options.doc_fr: Combien de scénarios aléatoires sont déverrouillés depuis le début (leurs éléments déverrouillés sont précollés). Le reste est fermé derrière les objets déverrouillés dans le multimonde.

options.name: Z-Fusion Logic
options.doc:
How Z-Fusion character checks are gated.
- full: Z-Fusion characters require their recipe ingredients (state.has).
- free: ingredients are auto-granted; Z-Fusion characters only require
  that you can reach the relevant content (lighter logic).
options.doc_fr:
Comment les contrôles de caractères Z-Fusion sont fermés.
- Les caractères Z-Fusion nécessitent leurs ingrédients de recette (état.has).
- gratuit: les ingrédients sont auto-accordés; les caractères Z-Fusion exigent seulement que vous puissiez atteindre le contenu pertinent ( logique plus légère).

options.name: Filler Ratio
options.doc:
Approximate percentage of non-progression locations filled with Zeni
filler (vs. useful Z-Item ability boosts). 0 = all useful, 100 = all Zeni.
options.doc_fr: Pourcentage approximatif d'emplacements de non-progression remplis de remplissage Zeni (versements utiles Z-Item). 0 = tous utiles, 100 = tous Zeni.

options.name: Difficulty Floor
options.doc:
Minimum game level a mission must be cleared on to count as a check /
toward scenario completion. any = Level 1+, hard = Level 3 only.

options.name: Randomize Fighters
options.doc:
Randomize the characters in Dragon Adventure fights (player team and/or
opponents). Deterministic per mission (same fight always randomizes the same
way for a given seed). Cosmetic/gameplay only — does NOT affect logic or
checks. 'off' disables it.
  both    = randomize player team and enemies
  enemies = randomize only opponents
  players = randomize only your team

options.name: Fighter Pool
options.doc:
Which characters randomized fighters can be drawn from.
any       = the entire 129-character roster
unlocked  = only characters you've unlocked so far (read live)

options.name: Disable Giants
options.doc:
When ON, giant-class fighters (Great Apes/Ozaru, Hirudegarn, Janemba,
Super Slug, Slug, etc.) are excluded from the fighter-randomizer pool, since
their size/arena behavior can be janky or unfair as randomized opponents.
Only affects randomized fighters; story fights are unchanged.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
When ON, losing a fight (Defeat or Surrender) sends a death to everyone
else in the multiworld also playing with DeathLink, and receiving a death
from another player zeroes your fighters' health to force a loss in your
current fight. If you're not in an active fight when a death arrives, it is
applied to your next fight.

options.name: Shop Checks
options.doc:
How many Item Shop purchase checks to add. The client takes over the
shop, hides all default items, and shows named check-items the player buys
to send checks. Each is detected by Zeni decreasing by that slot's unique
price (immune to AP item grants, which don't cost Zeni). 0 disables shop
checks. Capped at the number of confidently-named shop items (25).
options.doc_fr: Combien de contrôles d'achat d'article Shop à ajouter. Le client prend le contrôle de la boutique, cache tous les articles par défaut, et affiche les articles nommés check-items que le joueur achète pour envoyer des chèques. Chacun est détecté par Zeni en diminuant par le prix unique de cette fente (prime aux subventions d'articles AP, qui ne coûtent pas Zeni). 0 désactive les contrôles de magasin. Capturé au nombre d'articles de magasin avec confiance (25).

options.name: Shop Initial Slots
options.doc:
How many shop checks are available from the start. The rest are revealed
by receiving Shop Restock items.
options.doc_fr: Combien de contrôles sont disponibles dès le début. Les autres sont révélés par la réception des articles Shop Restock.

options.name: Shop Restock Amount
options.doc: How many additional shop checks each Shop Restock item reveals.
options.doc_fr: Combien de contrôles supplémentaires chaque article Shop Restock révèle.

options.name: Skip Cutscenes
options.doc:
When ON, the client automatically skips in-game Dragon Adventure dialogue
cutscenes the instant they start. The game performs its own clean scene
removal (the same effect as the in-game pause-menu Skip), so the scenario
continues normally afterward. This only affects in-engine dialogue scenes,
not pre-rendered FMV movies.

options.name: Skip Save Prompt
options.doc:
When ON, the client automatically dismisses the post-mission save prompt
("Save Game Data?" / "Exit Saving?") so you don't have to confirm it after
every mission. The game commits your progress (mission completion + the next
mission unlock) BEFORE the prompt appears, so nothing is lost — only the
memory-card write is skipped. The client confirms the prompts the game's own
way and only ever acts while the save prompt is actually on screen.

Note: because the memory-card write is skipped, in-game progress is not
persisted to the card, so it is lost on reboot. Your Archipelago checks are
safe (tracked server-side). Turn this OFF if you want normal saving.
